sentences.en: The mainstream media is the most prevalent practitioner of scaremongering.
sentences.zh: 主流媒体是最常见的恐慌制造者。

sentences.en: The English language became prevalent around the world for many reasons.
sentences.zh: 英语之所以在全世界流行开来，原因有很多。

sentences.en: Plastic is the most prevalent type of marine debris.
sentences.zh: 塑料是海洋垃圾中最常见的类型。

senses.zh: 流行的，盛行的,普遍存在的，普遍发生的
